name: board
description: Put notes, checklists, kanban boards, charts, diagrams, logs and questions on the user's stickypane board and read back what the user did there.

interface.shortDescription: A board in the terminal that the agent writes to and the user reads
interface.longDescription: stickypane shows a folder of plain files as panes in a terminal window next to the agent: notes, kanban boards, checklists, charts, Mermaid diagrams, logs followed live, scripts with a Run button, and forms the user answers with a key press. This plugin teaches the agent when and how to use it.
defaultPrompt: Put a checklist of this task on the board.
Show the plan on the board as a kanban.
Ask me on the board which option to take.
